title: 花旗资管Jeannie：AI之外，还有哪些风险要盯？
speaker: Jeannie

segments.en: So, on top of tighter monetary policy could be tighter, what other risks should be thinking about?
segments.zh: 除了货币政策可能进一步收紧，还有哪些风险需要关注？

segments.en: It is around AI and whether or not there are a couple of things. One is regulatory, what we've seen recently in the kind of like rhetoric, this concern around frontier models and the safety around it.
segments.zh: 主要围绕AI，有几点。一是监管，最近我们看到一些言论，关注前沿模型及其安全性。

segments.en: Could that prompt lawmakers to put in some movement on regulation? For us, we think the regulatory picture is that it's going to be more of a how, not an if, right?
segments.zh: 这会不会促使立法者推进监管？我们认为监管更多是“怎么做”的问题，而不是“会不会做”。

segments.en: Many industries are regulated. This one should be no different but how it gets implemented I think is a big question mark and would not be surprised for rhetoric to increase going into urine and certainly
segments.zh: 很多行业都受到监管，这个行业也不例外，但如何落地是个大问号，相关言论升温也不令人意外。

segments.en: we're seeing it as it relates to talks between China and the US. I think the other piece around AI is just the physical limitations.
segments.zh: 在中美谈判相关话题上也能看到这一点。AI的另一面是物理层面的限制。

segments.en: Can we build capacity as quickly as demand is calling for? And so that might cause some natural speed limits in just kind of how it all plays out.
segments.zh: 我们能否按需求的速度建设产能？这可能会给整个进程带来一些自然的限速。

segments.en: That for us might be more of a price action story rather than a fundamental earning story. And so those are kind of the two key pieces that we're watching outside of aggressive monetary policy.
segments.zh: 对我们来说，这更可能是价格走势层面的故事，而非基本面盈利的故事。这就是除激进货币政策外我们关注的两个关键点。

segments.en: Now, we'd think that the central banks across the globe will be hiking. Our expectation is that they're actually going to be fairly thoughtful about it to address inflation without creating a 2022 type scenario but that is one of the risks we're watching for, of course.
segments.zh: 我们认为全球央行会继续加息，但预期它们会相当审慎，在应对通胀的同时避免重演2022年的情形，这当然是我们关注的风险之一。

segments.en: Yeah, one would hope, one can, of course.
